# How to Download and Set Up the CCV App

April 22, 2026

Table of contents

[Step 1: Download the CCV App](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_0f437006ec)[Step 2: Open the App and Start Activation](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_6623f65e63)[Step 3: Retrieve Your DAC Code](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_327b4a4362)[Step 4: Enter the DAC Code](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_cfad68857b)[Step 5: Select Your Work Sites](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_480d2f8a97)[Keeping the App Updated](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_d107bf5434)[Need Help?](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_393d2d3207)[Final Steps](https://help.forwoodsafety.com/en/articles/10625086-how-to-download-and-set-up-the-ccv-app#h_a2f2a8fcde)

The Forwood CCV app helps you verify critical controls before starting high-risk work, ensuring a safer workplace. This guide walks you through downloading, activating, and setting up the app.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/tlmqy4u1/2125403281/cc167f1853bf8442a9053a77320e/image.png?expires=1794340800&signature=31e7fab900723d2af1a1241ef5c845e993e3b9773d03a94b3a3abab549d18561&req=diElE81%2BnoNXWPMW1HO4zTsUE46z06yQaMXELRsSQpFPX0NKFeeV2ncjyno4%0AqscY2tXJFL3CYvWbs%2Bk%3D%0A)](https://share.synthesia.io/embeds/videos/218e7f00-9629-46b0-af25-d73f3c2d3b60)

## Step 1: Download the CCV App

The CCV app is available for both iOS and Android devices.

Simply scan this download QR code on your device for iOS or Android to find the CCV App in your store.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/tlmqy4u1/2309357861/c657b008601598785bcec3b38af1/d6aed9be-7e97-4da0-a03b-2e2c38099a5c?expires=1794340800&signature=4cb6626c15ececcbf913bb7cdcfc040ea3d4d77be3d36a7f99c1ae6ab2e62632&req=diMnH8p7molZWPMW1HO4zSE9JkoBTlyU2l80onfCrBW%2FVCPr4inCfrjV3%2Bxj%0A0VCbMj7K9%2FNy6TMj5bI%3D%0A)

Alternatively follow these steps to install the App:

1. Open the **[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/vn/app/forwood-ccv/id1574565890)** (iOS) or **[Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.forwood.forwood_crm_2)** (Android).

2. If required, search for **Forwood CCV**.

3. Tap **Download** and install the app.


* * *

## Step 2: Open the App and Start Activation

After installation, you need to activate the app using a **Device Activation Code (DAC)**.

1. Open the **Forwood CCV app**.

2. The app will prompt you to enter a **Device Activation Code (DAC)**.

3. Your DAC is available in the **Forwood ID Portal**.


Check your email for the Forwood ID Portal **URL and login details**.

* * *

## Step 3: Retrieve Your DAC Code

1. **Log into the Forwood ID Portal** using the details provided in your email.

2. Navigate to **My Profile** (top right corner of the main page).

3. Scroll to the bottom and tap **Generate DAC**.

4. Your **unique DAC number and DAC QR code** will be displayed.


**Note:** You cannot use the same DAC number for multiple devices. You will have to generate separate DAC QR codes if you wish to install the CCV app onto other devices e.g. a tablet.

* * *

## Step 4: Enter the DAC Code

1. Return to the **CCV app**.

2. Choose one of the following methods:





   - **Scan the QR Code for your DAC or**

   - **Enter the DAC Manually and then login with username or email address.**


3. The app will begin syncing company data.





   - **Important:** Keep your phone awake while syncing.


* * *

## Step 5: Select Your Work Sites

1. Once syncing is complete, a list of available sites will appear.

2. Select the sites where you’ll be verifying controls.

3. Tap **Continue**.


* * *

## Keeping the App Updated

The Forwood CCV app frequently updates to ensure optimal functionality, security, The Forwood CCV app is regularly updated to ensure optimal functionality, security, and user experience. You can view the app’s current version number at the bottom of the Settings page.

### **Updates**

The Forwood CCV app does **not support automatic updates**. All updates must be completed manually via the App Store or Google Play Store.

### **For Android devices**

Open the Google Play Store, search for the Forwood CCV app, and tap **Update** if available.

### **For Apple iOS devices**

Open the App Store, search for the Forwood CCV app, and tap **Update** if available.

### **Company Policy Notifications**

If your organisation manages app updates, follow any internal IT policies or guidelines.

* * *

## Need Help?

If you need assistance, you can contact our support team via **Intercom Messenger** in the **Forwood ID Portal**.

* * *

## Final Steps

You’re now set up and ready to verify critical controls.

✅ Thank you for your commitment to safety!
